d:
Step into the spellbinding world of Chandrakanta, the landmark 1994 television epic that redefined mythological and fantasy storytelling on Indian television. Adapted from Devaki Nandan Khatri’s iconic 1888 novel and directed by Nirja Guleri, the show captivated an entire generation on Doordarshan.
This episode takes a comprehensive deep dive into the legendary rivalry between Vijaygarh and Naugarh, the perilous secrets of the magical Tilism, and the dramatic love story that kept millions glued to their television screens every Sunday morning.
